description: This PHP source file defines the InspectorScanClient class, which extends the AwsClient class and provides methods to interact with the AWS Inspector Scan service, including scanning SBOMs.

classes.name: InspectorScanClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the AWS Inspector Scan service, providing methods to initiate scans and retrieve results.

methods.name: scanSbom
methods.description: Synchronously initiates an SBOM scan via the Inspector Scan service.
